newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia proposes tax rebates for fund mgt firms.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia proposes tax rebates for fund mgt firms.

text.p: Malaysia has proposed offering income tax rebates for local fund management firms, Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said during his 1997 Budget speech on Friday.

Anwar said he proposed that the concessionary tax rate of 10 percent currently enjoyed by foreign fund management firms on income derived from the management of funds sourced from outside Malaysia be similarly extended to local fund managers.
He also proposed that gains derived by closed-end funds from investment be exempted from tax and the shareholders be given income tax exemption on dividends declared out of exempted income.
